name: Saritsyv
source:
Saritsyv (full name is Saritsyv Namira) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
An adult crimson green-eyed bearded om'verai. Belly blates and wing membranes are darker than scales. Horns have a sickle-like form, a big aread of a head is covered with various spikes.
Saritsyv is a depressive drunk man, abusing his only daughter time by time. On other hand, Saritsyv really cares about Elveos and is ready to do anything for her.
Cirrus and Ahros describe him as an "unpleasant man".
